title: 工作与学习
goal: 会介绍自己的工作内容、上下班时间、喜欢或不喜欢工作的哪些方面，也能聊学习和专业。
tips: What do you do? 问职业；What does your job involve? 问具体做什么。
说工作内容：I'm in charge of ... / I deal with ... / I work in sales（在销售部门）。
抱怨工作也很常见：I have to work overtime a lot.（经常加班）

exchanges.reply: I deal with customers and answer their questions.
exchanges.replyZh: 我负责对接客户、回答他们的问题。

exchanges.hear: What time do you finish work?
exchanges.reply: Usually at six, but sometimes I work overtime.
exchanges.replyZh: 一般六点，不过有时候加班。

exchanges.reply: Yes, I do. My colleagues are really nice.

exchanges.hear: What did you study at university?

exchanges.hearZh: 你看起来压力很大，今天很忙？
exchanges.reply: Yes, I have a big deadline on Friday.
exchanges.replyZh: 是啊，周五有个重要的截止日期。

exchanges.hear: Are you taking a day off tomorrow?

lines.en: I heard you got a new job. Congratulations!
lines.zh: 听说你找到新工作了，恭喜！
谢谢！上个月开始上班的。

lines.en: I work in marketing. I'm in charge of social media.
lines.zh: 我在市场部，负责社交媒体。

lines.en: Sounds interesting. How do you like it so far?
lines.zh: 听起来挺有意思。到目前为止觉得怎么样？

lines.en: I like it a lot. The only problem is the commute.
lines.zh: 我很喜欢，唯一的问题是通勤。

lines.en: Oh, how long does it take?
About an hour each way. But I can work from home on Fridays.
lines.zh: 单程大约一小时。不过周五可以在家办公。

lines.en: That's not bad. And are your colleagues nice?
Yes, they're very friendly. My boss is great too.
